1.mascotDialogue: One edge, two entries in the adjacency matrix. Forget the second, and you have quietly built half a directed graph instead. An unfinished thought.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3 are not optional companions to one another — they are the same conceptual edge, and must be added as a single, atomic pair, every time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowheads this time — merely a plain line, because the connection is inherently mutual.

4.mascotDialogue: The visual shows a single arrowhead where an undirected graph should never have one at all — this mismatch is the bug, and rather difficult to miss.
